DBCORP.NS.d: D. B. Corp Limited engages in newspaper printing and publishing, radio broadcasting, event management, and integrated internet and mobile interactive service businesses in India and internationally. The company operates through Printing/Publishing and Allied Businesses, and Radio segments. It publishes Dainik Bhaskar, Divya Bhaskar, Divya Marathi, Saurashtra Samachar, and DB Star newspapers in 3 languages, such as Hindi, Gujarati, and Marathi.

DICIND.NS.d: DIC India Limited manufactures and sells printing inks in India. It operates in two segments, Printing Inks and Lamination Adhesives. The company offers offset inks, gravure inks, flexo inks, can coatings, news inks, and packaging adhesives; lamination adhesives; UV and water based varnishes; packaging solutions; chemical solution materials, including fine chemicals, polymers, compounds, and application materials; and value added services to the printing fraternity.

EVERESTIND.NS.d: Everest Industries Limited manufactures and trades in building products for residential, commercial, and industrial applications in India. The company operates through Building Products and Steel Buildings segments. It offers building products, such as fiber cement roofing sheets, Durasteel colored metal roofing sheets, polycarbonate roofing sheets, EPDM washers, fiber cement boards, cement wood planks, ceilings, stone claddings, and heavy duty boards and readymade walls, as well as Rapicon walls.

GREAVESCOT.NS.d: Greaves Cotton Limited manufactures and sells engines and engine application products in India. It offers lightweight diesel/gasoline engines for automotive engine applications, such as 3-wheelers and small 4-wheeled commercial vehicles; non-automotive small engines for agriculture, construction, marine, and other industries; and industrial and firefighting engines.

GRETEX-SM.NS.d: Gretex Industries is involved in textile manufacturing. They produce a range of fabrics and textile products for various applications. GRETEX INDUSTRIES is located in India.

GRSE.NS.d: Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Limited operates as a shipbuilding company in India. The company offers frigates, anti-submarine warfare corvettes, missile corvettes, landing ship tanks, landing craft utilities, survey vessels, fleet replenishment tankers, fast patrol vessels, offshore patrol vessels, inshore patrol vessels, WJ-FAC, hover crafts, and fast interceptor boats to the Indian Navy, Indian Coast Guard, MHA, and other governments.

GSPLTRANS.NS.d: GSPL Transmission Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker GSPLTRANS and traded in INR. Its country is India.

HORIZONIND.NS.d: Horizon Industrial Parks Ltd. develops, owns and operates industrial and logistics infrastructure and leases out industrial, light manufacturing and warehousing space. The company was founded on 22 September 2009 and has its head office in Mumbai, India.

INCREDIBLE.NS.d: Incredible Industries Limited, renamed from Adhunik Industries Limited in May 2021, makes and sells iron and steel products in India, such as TMT bars, wire rods and H.B. wire, with related support services. It also generates wind power and exports its goods. Established in 1979, it is headquartered in Kolkata.

INFOBEAN.NS.d: InfoBeans Technologies Limited, a software services company, develops enterprise software in India and internationally. The company offers cloud computing, migration, configuration, deployment, and sustenance; enterprise mobility; and UX and UI design services, as well as distributed storage systems, and eCommerce platforms for mobile and web.

KAUSHALYA.NS.d: Kaushalya Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited primarily engages in executing construction contracts relating to infrastructure and real estate developments in India. The company operates in two segments, Construction and Hotel. It develops highways, bridges, and industrial infrastructure; electrification and irrigation projects; and residential and commercial complexes. The company is also involved in the operation of hotels; and acquisition, development, and sale of land.

KNRCON.NS.d: KNR Constructions Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates as an infrastructure development company in India. The company provides engineering, procurement, and construction services for roads and highways, irrigation, and urban water infrastructure management sectors. It undertakes various infrastructure projects, such as expressways, national highways, flyovers, bridges and viaducts, irrigation projects, urban development-civic amenities, and commercial and residential projects.

KSB.NS.d: KSB Limited manufactures and sells power driven pumps and industrial valves in India and internationally. The company operates through Pumps and Valves segments. The Pumps segment manufactures and trades in industrial pumps, submersible pumps, effluent treatment pumps, etc.; and offers related spares and services. The Valves segment manufactures and trades in industrial valves, and related spares and services. It also produces castings for captive consumption.

MADHAV.NS.d: Madhav Marbles and Granites Limited manufactures, processes, and trades in granite and marble slabs and tiles in India. It also provides sandstone, quartz, and tile products. The company exports its products to the United States, Canada, Europe, Australia, South Africa, Russia, and the Far East. It is also involved in the windmill power generation and real estate businesses. The company was founded in 1989 and is based in Udaipur, India.

MVGJL.NS.d: Manoj Vaibhav Gems 'N' Jewellers Limited is a jewelry retailer operating mainly in India. It sells gold and diamond ornaments in traditional styles, such as bangles, harams and mangalsutras, and modern ones like earrings, chains, rings and necklaces. It also trades gold and silver coins and offers silver articles for gifts, pooja and household use.

NILAINFRA.NS.d: Nila Infrastructures Limited constructs and develops infrastructure and real estate projects in India. The company is involved in the construction of civic urban infrastructure projects, including bus stations, multilevel parking, medical college, bus port, office complex, community hall, and other projects. It also develops residential real estate properties, such as flats and apartments; and leases commercial properties. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

PGEL.NS.d: PG Electroplast Limited provides electronic manufacturing and plastic injection molding services for original equipment manufacturers in India and internationally.

RAJVIR.NS.d: Rajvir Industries Limited primarily manufactures, processes, and sells yarns in India. It offers cotton, organic, fair-trade, and combed yarns; blended yarns, including polyester, viscose, modal, spun silk, and flame-retardant; and melange/heather, modal, synthetic, and cheese-dyed yarns. The company also provides fashion yarns, super specialty blends, technical textile products, and eco-friendly and fancy yarns.

RRIL.NS.d: RRIL Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker RRIL and traded in INR. Its country is India.

SHREECEM.NS.d: Shree Cement Limited manufactures and sells cement and clinker in India and internationally. It offers cement under the Shee Jung Rodhak, Bangur, Rockstrong, Roofon Concrete Master, and Bangur Power brand names. The company also engages in the generation of power with a total capacity of 742 megawatts through thermal, waste heat recovery, solar, and wind power plants. Shree Cement Limited was incorporated in 1979 and is based in Kolkata, India.

SKSTEXTILE-SM.NS.d: S K S Textiles Ltd is an Indian textile manufacturing company. The company is engaged in the production of yarn, fabric, and garments. S K S Textiles Ltd is based in Tamil Nadu, India.

SONAMAC.NS.d: Sona Machinery Ltd. is an Indian original equipment manufacturer and supplier specializing in agro-processing machinery. The company primarily operates within the agro-processing and grain milling industries, providing solutions for processing various grains such as rice, pulses, wheat, sesame, millet, corn, barley, gram, lentils, and seeds.

SSFL.NS.d: Srivari Spices & Foods Ltd. is an Indian Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) company headquartered in Hyderabad, primarily engaged in the manufacturing and marketing of spices and flour within the consumer staples sector. The company offers a diverse range of products under the "Srivari" brand, including pure spices such as red chili, turmeric, and coriander, alongside various blended spices like Madras Sambar Masala, Chicken Masala, Garam Masala, Mutton Masala, Pav Bhaji Masala, and Sabzi Masala.

SVGLOBAL.NS.d: S V Global Mill Limited is an Indian company engaged in the textile industry. The company manufactures and sells various textile products. Its headquarters are likely located in India, but further details are not readily available.

TATACHEM.NS.d: Tata Chemicals Limited manufactures, sells, and distributes basic chemistry and specialty products in India, Europe, Africa, the United States, rest of Asia, and internationally.

TECHM.NS.d: Tech Mahindra Limited provides information technology (IT) services and solutions in the Americas, Europe, India, and internationally. The company operates through IT Business and Business Processing Outsourcing (BPO) segments. It offers IT outsourcing, consulting, application outsourcing, network, infrastructure outsourcing, integrated engineering, BPO, platform, and mobile value added services.

TI.NS.d: Tilaknagar Industries Ltd. manufactures and sells Indian made foreign liquor and its related products in India. The company's products include whisky, brandy, rum, vodka, and gin. It offers brandy under the Mansion House and Courier Napoleon brands; whisky under the Mansion House, Senate Royal, and Senate Royale Red brands; rum under the Madiraa brand; and gin under the Blue Lagoon brand. The company also exports its products in East and South-East Asia, Africa, the Middle East, and Europe.

TORNTPOWER.NS.d: Torrent Power Limited, an integrated power utility, engages in the generation, transmission, and distribution of electricity in the states of Gujarat, Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, and Karnataka in India. It owns thermal and renewable power plants with a generating capacity of approximately 3,879 MW.

TUNWAL.NS.d: Tunwal E-Motors Ltd. is an Indian automotive company that specializes in the design, development, manufacturing, and distribution of electric two-wheelers. The company's primary product offering includes a range of electric scooters, with models such as the Lithino, Elektrika, and Roma Series, totaling over 23 distinct scooter models across various variants.

VARDHACRLC.NS.d: Vardhman Acrylics Limited manufactures and supplies acrylic fiber and tow in India. The company markets its products under the VARLAN brand name. Vardhman Acrylics Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Ludhiana, India. Vardhman Acrylics Limited is a subsidiary of Vardhman Textiles Limited.

VTMLTD.NS.d: VTM Limited is an Indian company that manufactures and sells various textile products. They cater to diverse markets within the textile industry. The company is based in India.

WABAG.NS.d: VA Tech Wabag Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, supply, installation, construction, and operational management of drinking water, waste and industrial water treatment, and desalination plants in India and internationally.

ZIMLAB.NS.d: Nagpur-based ZIM Laboratories Limited has been a pharmaceutical business since 1984, developing, producing and supplying finished dosage forms and pre-formulation ingredients in India and abroad. It offers technology-based drug delivery and non-infringing manufacturing processes for generic medicines, in forms ranging from granules and pellets to tablets, capsules and oral thin films.
